title: 第15章 吾四海村天地正神赐你死亡第16章 神只有敌邪祟诡异
slug: 全民成野神唯有我百倍供品
content_zh:
“神……神只？！”
狼妖心中惊恐到了极点。
它看着那落下的金色光辉。
感受着那金色光辉中恐怖浩瀚的神威，心胆俱裂。
这——
这怎么可能！
这世上居然真的有神只！
传说中的神只，竟然就出现在了自己面前！
它巨大的妖躯在这股恐怖的神威之下瑟瑟发抖，立即跪在了地上恐惧万分道：
“神只老爷饶命！”
“神只老爷饶命啊！”
“小妖再也不敢害人了！
小妖愿意臣服神只老爷、侍奉神只老爷！”
“神只老爷饶了小妖一命吧！”
它恐惧、颤抖的跪地祈求。
巨大的狼躯跪在地上，这一幕相当震撼。
李德阳、李修武等人面露震惊。
这就是神只之威吗？
彰越公都没有出现，只是神威浩荡而出，不可一世恐怖之极的千狼山狼妖，就跪在了地上！
他们心中对于彰越公的信仰都变得更加虔诚，甚至有了几分狂热！

此时此刻——
金色光辉浩浩荡荡，甚至在苍穹上形成了一道巨大的金色面孔。
面孔模糊不清，但一双眼眸却极为清楚，漠然而威严。
高高在上的俯视着下方跪地祈命的妖狼。
这一幕。
让山下的几名张家村、廖家村村民都看傻了眼。
他们张大了嘴巴，呆呆的望着那巨大金色面孔。
神威汹涌而来，几人都感到自己无比渺小。
“那……那……那……”
一名年轻人结结巴巴开口，话都说不出来。
实在是太过震惊了。
而且——
刚刚他们也听到了李有鸣的大声怒喝，听到了那一句‘请彰越公神威降临’！
更看到了惊天长虹横跨而来，落入千狼山中，形成金色的巨大面孔！
content_en:
"God... God?!"
The wolf demon was extremely frightened.
It looked at the falling golden light.
Feeling the terrifying and vast divine power in the golden light, my heart was shattered.
This——
How is this possible!
There are actually gods in this world!
The legendary god actually appeared in front of him!
Its huge monster body shivered under this terrifying divine power, and it immediately knelt on the ground and said with great fear:
"Master God, have mercy on me!"
"Master God, have mercy on me!"
"The little demon doesn't dare to harm anyone anymore!
The little demon is willing to surrender to the god and serve the god! "
"Master God, please spare the little demon's life!"
It knelt down in fear and trembling to pray.
The huge wolf body was kneeling on the ground. This scene was quite shocking.
Li Deyang, Li Xiuwu and others looked shocked.
Is this the power of gods?
Duke Zhangyue didn't even show up, but the powerful and terrifying Qianlangshan Wolf Demon knelt on the ground!
Their belief in Zhang Yue Gong has become more pious and even a little fanatical!
At this moment——
The golden light was so vast that it even formed a huge golden face in the sky.
The face was blurry, but the eyes were extremely clear, indifferent and majestic.
He looked down at the demon wolf kneeling below, praying for his life.
This scene.
Several villagers from Zhangjia Village and Liaojia Village down the mountain were dumbfounded.
They opened their mouths wide and stared blankly at the huge golden face.
The divine power surged forward, making several people feel extremely small.
"That...that...that..."
A young man stammered, unable to speak.
It was so shocking.
And——
They also heard Li Youming's loud shouts just now, and heard the words "Please bring the divine power of Duke Zhangyue to come"!
I even saw the sky-shattering rainbow coming across and falling into Qianlang Mountain, forming a huge golden face!
